# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Fresh run (no prior iterations; seed already mature). Diagnosed all 22 failing trajectories
via 4 parallel read-only subagents (groups A–D), clustered by shared root cause, then shipped
4 additive/narrowed prose edits.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Overwrote cells whose gold = the cell's own ORIGINAL input | 39046, 51359, 30709, 59259, 56637, 56427 | Treated answer_position as "rewrite every cell"; clobbered blank-source rows / given-example cells / originals; some cleared+rebuilt the range | CONTRACT | Output-contract clarification, NARROWED to fill/compute tasks |
| 2 | Correct value stored as TEXT (or wrong number/date type) | 56427 (14 cells), 51958, +450-9 int/str, 50630 (keep-text dir) | openpyxl returns cell values as str; agent copies numeric/date-looking text through verbatim, or writes the string form of a date | KNOWLEDGE/mechanism | Type-casting mechanism bullet |
| 3 | Modern-function formula written without `_xlfn.` → `#NAME?` | 47741 | TEXTJOIN etc. must be stored as `_xlfn.TEXTJOIN`; agent stripped the prefix the original cell had | KNOWLEDGE gap | Add fact + worked idiom |
| 4 | Re-derived from raw data instead of the workbook's own formula | 11842 | Gold mirrors the sheet's existing helper/summary columns; independent recount diverges on edge cases → "LOWER" | KNOWLEDGE/method | Heuristic in prompt.md |
| — | Hard logic / ambiguous / inconsistent-gold (SKIPPED) | 53367, 3911, 325-44, 59743, 56996, 57090, 55931, 50051, 5192, 38332 | boolean-vs-count, scarce-resource allocation, cartesian order, instruction-contradicts-gold, wrong range detection, per-year vs global dedup, name-match vs row-align, padding-zeros, inconsistent worked example, "just-in-case" branch | — | none (not prose-fixable / regression-risk) |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | CONTRACT (narrowed) | task_template.md | "answer_position is the MAXIMUM region; for FILL/COMPUTE tasks change only cells the instruction produces a value for; leave source-blank & given-example cells at original value; edit in place, don't clear+rebuild." Explicitly excludes delete/sort/dedup/insert. | Yes — scoped so the passing VBA delete/dedup/sort/highlight tasks (94-8,160-6,185-13,448-11,458-49,73-45,435-38,587-38,110-2) are untouched |
| 2 | KNOWLEDGE/mechanism | task_template.md | "values read from cells may be str; cast numeric/date-looking text to real int/float/datetime when target is numeric; keep text as text otherwise." Explains the openpyxl gotcha, both directions. | Additive; passing type tasks (58047,1563,58147) already get type right — mechanism doesn't change the type judgment |
| 3 | KNOWLEDGE + idiom | task_template.md | "`_xlfn.` prefix required for modern functions; reuse the token verbatim from the existing cell; classic funcs need no prefix." | Additive; passing classic-function formula tasks (44266,16511,46897,55667,56975) explicitly excluded |
| 4 | KNOWLEDGE/method | prompt.md | "prefer replicating existing workbook formulas/helper columns over re-deriving from raw data." Phrased as preference. | Low risk; only bites when helper columns exist AND agent would recompute differently |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)
- Edit 1 → traces 39046/51359/30709/59259/56637 all show grader msg "CHANGED although the expected value is the cell's own original input"; agent looped over the whole range assigning values (e.g. 56637 wrote labels into every cell; 450-9 cleared+rebuilt). New rule tells it to write only the computed cells and leave the rest at their loaded value → those cells now match gold. Passing restructure tasks excluded by the explicit "delete/sort/dedup/insert" carve-out.
- Edit 2 → trace 56427 grader: "14 cells hold the CORRECT value stored as text instead of as a number" (agent copied col-G string '1.3' verbatim); 51958 wrote date as string. New casting rule makes the agent write real int/float/datetime → type matches. 50630 (datetime where str) is the reverse and is preserved by the "keep text as text" clause.
- Edit 3 → trace 47741: original cell was `=_xlfn.TEXTJOIN(...)`, agent wrote `=TEXTJOIN(...)`; grader: "unresolved formula written out as its error string (#NAME)". New rule + "reuse token verbatim" → prefix retained → recalc succeeds.
- Edit 4 → trace 11842: gold = `(Σ months AGr + AG(r+1))/2` off existing summary columns; agent recomputed from raw daily cells and got 2 cells "LOWER". New heuristic steers it to mirror the existing summary columns → matches gold.

## Blast-radius per edit
- Edit 1: BOUNDED — additive + condition-gated (only fill/compute, explicitly not restructuring). Passing tasks in the class already write only the correct cells (they pass), so no behavior flip.
- Edit 2: BOUNDED — additive clarification of an output contract passing tasks already satisfy; both type directions preserved.
- Edit 3: BOUNDED — additive knowledge scoped to modern functions; classic-function tasks explicitly excluded.
- Edit 4: BOUNDED — soft preference; no global decision/permission rule changed.

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 4 parallel read-only Explore subagents (groups A–D) diagnosed all 22 failing traces; I synthesized clusters and applied edits serially. Also spot-checked passing-task types directly to size Edit 1's blast radius (found the VBA delete/dedup class — the reason Edit 1 is narrowed).
- Prior iterations read: none exist (fresh run; LEDGER/JOURNAL/RUNMAP empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- Did NOT touch the existing "may be '-' / #N/A → write that exact literal" rule: it is bidirectional/task-dependent (59259 wanted int 0, others want the literal), and altering it globally is a regression trap.
- Did NOT ban or restructure formula/XML/rich-text guidance (prior-run memory flagged those as regressors).
- Edit 1 is deliberately scoped to fill/compute — the whole-range-rewrite passing tasks depend on being allowed to restructure.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- 53367 (boolean vs count), 59743 (instruction contradicts gold), 325-44 & 3911 (ambiguous ordering/allocation), 56996 (range mis-detection), 57090 (per-year vs global dedup), 55931 (name-match vs row-align), 50051 (padding-zero interpretation): hard logic / ambiguous / inconsistent-gold — not a knowledge gap, prose can't teach the specific computation.
- 5192, 38332: agent broke rules it already has (copied preview example; added a "just-in-case" branch) — behavioral, restating would be wasted prose.
